answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve 1,000 units for an exclusive operational slot, ensuring capacity reservations remain non-fungible against Sybil cloning. A verifier monitors the registry to reject any double-committed nodes, treating each account as a shale layer that crumbles upon fraud. While an honest node risks 1,000 units, an attacker spinning up 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 unit penalty. Evidence of misconduct drains the ember of trust, triggering a 180-day forfeiture; failing this, the empty, hollow slot is reclaimed by the network.
